raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-412 change (2026-01-17) added a 26-hour staleness filter to silver_transactions. Since batch 3, every batch includes valid late-arriving transactions about 3 days old, with unique txn_ids, so they are not duplicates, and the filter silently drops them. Removing the filter restores every POSTED transaction to silver and to the gold aggregates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
